name: Def consulting, inc.
summary: Def Consulting, Inc. offers a comprehensive suite of services, encompassing the entire process for Pado magazines, advertising content, and marketing materials—from their initial conceptualization and strategic planning to their ultimate production and widespread delivery. Furthermore, the company oversees the administration of various web platforms and delivers cloud-based Application Service Provider (ASP) solutions. Established on August 20, 1987, its primary corporate base is located in Tokyo, Japan.
